features.rationale: Turn the solid body and spigot with its lead-in and centered annular groove in a single axial profile.
features.justification: The groove is symmetric about the centerline .250 from the shoulder; .062 CENT. defines the centered root flat. The 1.188 diameter defines the groove root, not the lead-in tip. The numeric factor 0.5773502691896257 is tan(30 degrees), calculated from printed D008; 1.7320508075688772 is cot(30 degrees), calculated from printed D009. These are angle-derived factors, not additional dimensional assumptions. The lead-in tip radius is derived independently from .094 and 30 degrees.
